comment: Registry of per-screen matched-screenshot acceptance. See docs/NATIVE_DESKTOP_SCREENSHOT_ACCEPTANCE.md for the rules: every screen names its capture seam, an explicit tolerance (identical pixels or a documented band with a named fluctuating source), and an optional approved source reference. New capture seams register here.

screens.tolerance_reason: independent capture runs on the reference stand differ by 60-200 of 1,296,000 pixels (sub-pixel text antialiasing flicker in QML repaints under llvmpipe, measured 2026-11-10); band set 20x above the observed max channel mean 0.0005/255
